items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: her name was Viola Haynes when she married, but it was Viola Adams before she married.

ctx.x: That's right. You came from out- Yes, uh-huh. Is that west of here, like near the- New Liberia or-

I don't know anything about small towns in Louisiana, real and truly. I can tell you all about Texas, because my husband and I used to travel out in Texas. But here, I mean, we didn't go anywhere. My grandmother was old, and my aunt was having children every 18 months, and we just didn't get a chance to go anywhere. And her name was Viola Haynes when she married, but it was Viola Adams before she married. Yeah.
And all of your aunts and uncles are dead now? Every one of them, even the in-laws. They're all dead.
